(EOG) was held on May 20, 2026, via live webcast, for the following purposes: (i) to elect nine directors to hold office until EOG&#8217;s 2027 annual meeting of stockholders and until their respective successors are duly elected and qualified; (ii) to ratify the appointment by the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors (Board) of Deloitte &amp; Touche LLP, independent registered public accounting firm, as EOG&#8217;s auditors for the year ending December 31, 2026; and (iii) to hold a non-binding advisory vote on the compensation of EOG&#8217;s named executive officers.</span></div><div><span><br/></span></div><div style="text-align:justify"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">                At the close of business on March 23, 2026, the record date for the 2026 Annual Meeting, there were 535,715,814 shares of EOG common stock issued, outstanding and entitled to vote at the 2026 Annual Meeting.
